entry.title: Show HN: Kios - An iOS e-reader app with kobo, kosync and OPDS support (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Hey all! I love reading on my Kobo, especially paired with a self-hosted server that speaks the Kobo sync protocol. The one catch: it doesn't fit in my pocket, so I can't always take it with me. So I built my own iOS e-reader that syncs reading progress over a few different protocols: - kosync - OPDS 1 and 2.0 - Kobo sync The idea: read a few pages on your phone during a commute, then pick up exactly where you left off on your e-reader at home - and vice versa. It's called Kios and it's currently in open TestFlight beta. If that sounds useful, I'd love for you to try it. I set up a Discord for issues and feature requests: https://discord.gg/spTFCkhP Keep on reading! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48361675 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
